actions.reason: RegexTokenizer.train fast path (chunk with a single occurrence of p0): splice the merged token into the chunk's private id list in place instead of building it from three slices and two concatenations, and subtract the merged pair's count once after the loop instead of once per chunk. No neighbour pair in the fast path can equal the merged pair, and stats[pair] is not read before the final subtraction, so stats, heap pushes and merges are identical. Evaluate: train_ir ratio 0.9856, equivalence identical, all tests pass.
